company.distributes: Certified organic groceries with branded chocolate (Loving Earth), snacks (Kitz) and nut spreads (Food to Nourish), plus vegan and gluten free foods
company.channels_supplied: Its Sydney stores (click and collect sites for Enmore and Turramurra) and its online click and collect shop
what_they_do_well: Features its suppliers, such as Loving Earth and Food to Nourish, on a dedicated Our Suppliers page.
company.fit_rationale: A Sydney organic grocer with at least two stores whose own supplier page names the chocolate, snack and spread brands it sells. Its vegan and gluten free shelves suit Diablo's vegan spreads, jams and muesli bars. Exact store count is not stated on its website.

company.name: United Petroleum (Quickstop)
company.distributes: Snacks, food, drinks and groceries, including muffins and cookies from other brands (Pie Face)
company.channels_supplied: United Petroleum service stations with Quickstop convenience stores, expanding in Victoria
what_they_do_well: Opened two new sites in Melbourne's west, Truganina and Yarraville, in September 2024.
company.fit_rationale: Fuel and convenience network whose Quickstop stores sell snacks, cookies, muffins and groceries from other brands. Diablo's cookies, cakes and chocolate fit its snack range. Site count is not stated on its website.

company.name: Wholefood Merchants
company.channel: Gluten free and free from shops
company.distributes: Chocolate, sweets, biscuits, cakes and cookies, snack bars and nut butters and fruit spreads, with gluten free and allergy friendly ranges
company.channels_supplied: Large store in Ferntree Gully and its own online shop with Australia-wide delivery
what_they_do_well: Over 35,000 products in store and more than 6,000 online, with over 20 years in the health food trade.
company.fit_rationale: A large health food store with dedicated gluten free and allergy friendly ranges and categories for chocolate, sweets, biscuits and cookies, snack bars and spreads from health brands. Diablo's stevia sweetened ranges suit its free from shoppers in store and online.
